views.v_availability_summary: SELECT a.day, a.hour, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_free) AS free_cnt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT a.is_free)) AS busy_cnt, count(*) AS known_cnt FROM (availability_hour a JOIN participant p ON ((p.id = a.participant_id))) WHERE (p.status <> 'archived'::text) GROUP BY a.day, a.hour;
views.v_balance: SELECT ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(dues_charge.amount_due), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM dues_charge) AS dues_total, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(budget_tx.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM budget_tx WHERE ((budget_tx.tx_type = 'income'::text) AND (budget_tx.status = 'confirmed'::text))) AS income_tx, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(budget_tx.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM budget_tx WHERE ((budget_tx.tx_type = 'expense'::text) AND (budget_tx.status = 'confirmed'::text))) AS expense_tx, ((( SELECT COALESCE(sum(dues_charge.amount_due), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM dues_charge) + ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(budget_tx.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM budget_tx WHERE ((budget_tx.tx_type = 'income'::text) AND (budget_tx.status = 'confirmed'::text)))) - ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(budget_tx.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM budget_tx WHERE ((budget_tx.tx_type = 'expense'::text) AND (budget_tx.status = 'confirmed'::text)))) AS balance;
views.v_dues_balance: SELECT p.id AS participant_id, p.display_name, d.period, d.amount_due, d.amount_paid, (d.amount_due - d.amount_paid) AS balance, d.status FROM (dues_charge d JOIN participant p ON ((p.id = d.participant_id))) WHERE (d.amount_due <> d.amount_paid);

views.v_intent_degraded: SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, ts))::date AS "день", COALESCE(degraded_reason, 'не записано'::text) AS "причина", CASE WHEN (degraded_reason = ANY (ARRAY['chat_tokens'::text, 'chat_steps'::text, 'token_budget'::text])) THEN 'бюджет'::text WHEN (degraded_reason = ANY (ARRAY['timeout'::text, 'llm_unavailable'::text, 'llm_error'::text, 'provider_timeout'::text])) THEN 'провайдер'::text WHEN (degraded_reason = 'step_limit'::text) THEN 'агент'::text WHEN (degraded_reason IS NULL) THEN 'не записано'::text ELSE 'прочее'::text END AS "вид", count(*) AS "отказов" FROM intent_log WHERE (agent_status = 'refusal'::text) GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, ts))::date), COALESCE(degraded_reason, 'не записано'::text), CASE WHEN (degraded_reason = ANY (ARRAY['chat_tokens'::text, 'chat_steps'::text, 'token_budget'::text])) THEN 'бюджет'::text WHEN (degraded_reason = ANY (ARRAY['timeout'::text, 'llm_unavailable'::text, 'llm_error'::text, 'provider_timeout'::text])) THEN 'провайдер'::text WHEN (degraded_reason = 'step_limit'::text) THEN 'агент'::text WHEN (degraded_reason IS NULL) THEN 'не записано'::text ELSE 'прочее'::text END;
views.v_intent_gaps: SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, ts))::date AS day, count(*) AS "всего", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (source = 'llm'::text)) AS "разобрала_модель", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (source = ANY (ARRAY['buttons'::text, 'human_new'::text]))) AS "спросили_человека", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT resolved)) AS "не_записано" FROM intent_log WHERE (agent_status IS NULL) GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, ts))::date) ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, ts))::date) DESC;
